aligned-adamstown.note: The state air permit to construct covers 168 diesel generators of 3 MW and 4 of 1 MW, 508 MW in all. Added as Aligned Frederick Data Center power station.

rowan-digital-infrastruc-frederick.note: Rowan's Bauxite I campus is leased to Amazon, and the state air permit for it is held by Amazon Data Services. The 92 large generators match the Rowan site plan. Added as Amazon Frederick Data Center power station, 257.75 MW.

amazon-frederick-iad534.note: Amazon's second Frederick air permit application, for buildings IAD-534 to IAD-537, lists 99 diesel generators, 257.75 MW. Added at announced. I did not find it on the Public Service Commission exemption docket.

rowan-bauxite-iii-frederick.note: County planners approved Bauxite III but no generator count or air application names it. It is on the watch list with watch case no generation, recheck January 2027.

quantum-loophole-adamstown.note: This is the campus on the former Eastalco site. Its two tenants with air permits are covered by two records: Aligned Frederick (508 MW) and Amazon Frederick (257.75 MW, the Rowan Bauxite I buildings). I found no other generator permit for the campus.

us-md:new:aligned-frederick-data-center-.evidence: The overlap is the county. The two Amazon records in this batch are also in Frederick County, but Aligned's site at 5601 Manor Woods Road belongs to another company and has its own permit for 168 large and 4 small engines.

us-md:new:amazon-frederick-data-center-p.evidence: The Amazon IAD-534 record in this batch lists the same mix of 99 generators and uses the same approximate point. They are still two plants. This record is buildings BWI-150 to BWI-153 at 3250 Digital Drive under the permit issued March 25, 2026. The IAD-534 application covers other buildings and says it is a separate source from BWI-150, about 0.59 miles away. Both points are placeholders and need their own sites.

us-md:new:amazon-frederick-iad-534-data-.evidence: The Amazon Frederick record in this batch lists the same mix of 99 generators and uses the same approximate point. They are still two plants. This application covers buildings IAD-534 to IAD-537 and says it is a separate source from BWI-150, about 0.59 miles away. The BWI-150 buildings at 3250 Digital Drive are in the other record. Both points are placeholders and need their own sites.
